Epic covering login, logout, sessions, CSRF and role-based access control.
Epic covering in-clinic appointment booking, cancellation and doctor management.

Epic covering testing evidence, diagrams, documents, JIRA evidence and final submission.

Summary: Write SRS with functional and non-functional requirements
Description: Author the Software Requirements Specification for VEYORA covering stakeholders, functional requirements (auth, booking, health logs, reminders, risk workspace), non-functional requirements, constraints and acceptance criteria. Linked requirement set REQ-AUTH/BOOK/LOG/REM/RISK/DATA.
Acceptance Criteria: SRS document exists in docs/ and DOCX export; every implemented feature traces to a requirement ID; out-of-scope list matches the implemented exclusions.

Summary: Build initial risk register with scored entries
Description: Seed the risk register with the six identified academic risks (unauthorized access, duplicate booking, invalid data entry, database loss, development delay, stale reminders) with probability/impact 1-5 and owner Krisha Mange. RISK-01..RISK-06.
Acceptance Criteria: All six risks exist with scores = P x I and academic bands; controls start as Planned unless already implemented; linked to requirements.

column12: Create editable Draw.io diagrams consistent with the implemented system: use-case, system architecture, ER, appointment activity and appointment sequence diagrams. Linked: DDS section 2.
column13: Five .drawio files plus exported images in diagrams/; no components drawn that are not implemented.

Summary: Implement authentication with hashed passwords and server sessions
Description: Implement POST /api/auth/login and /api/auth/logout with werkzeug password hashing, server-managed HttpOnly SameSite=Lax sessions, CSRF token issuance and enforcement on state-changing routes. REQ-AUTH-01. RISK-01 mitigation.
Acceptance Criteria: Correct login returns user + CSRF token; wrong password -> 401; logout invalidates session; state change without CSRF -> 403; tests test_auth.py pass.

Description: Enforce per-endpoint role checks: PATIENT only own appointments/logs/reminders; DOCTOR only own appointments; PROJECT_MANAGER only project workspace. Never trust role or IDs from the browser. REQ-AUTH-01. RISK-01.
Acceptance Criteria: Cross-role requests return 403; cross-patient record access returns 404 (no info leak); tests test_authorization.py pass.

Summary: Implement slot generation and doctor listing
Description: Generate doctor availability from weekly rosters relative to the runtime date (Asia/Kolkata); list doctors with specialties and working days for patients. REQ-BOOK-01.
Acceptance Criteria: Slots are future-only; non-clinic days produce no slots; slot responses contain no other patient identities.

Description: Transactional INSERT with partial unique index on (doctor_id, date, start_time) WHERE status=CONFIRMED; HTTP 409 on conflict; friendly message; doctor/date preserved in UI. REQ-BOOK-02. RISK-02 mitigation.
Acceptance Criteria: Valid booking -> 201; second patient for same slot -> 409; concurrent race yields exactly one 201 and one 409; past slots -> 400; tests test_appointments.py pass.

Summary: Implement cancellation and doctor status transitions
Description: Patient cancels own appointment; doctor marks COMPLETED or CANCELLED; CONFIRMED->{COMPLETED,CANCELLED} only; cancellation releases the slot. REQ-BOOK-04, REQ-BOOK-05.
Acceptance Criteria: Invalid transitions -> 400; other users' appointments -> 403; after cancel another patient can book the slot -> 201.

Summary: Build patient booking UI (doctor -> date -> slot -> review)
Description: Four-step booking flow with specialty filter chips, runtime-generated future dates, slot grid, review screen, success animation, and 409 conflict banner that keeps doctor + date. In-clinic only.
Acceptance Criteria: Flow completes end to end; conflict shows friendly message; reduced-motion users get no decorative animation.

Summary: Implement health logs with dual validation
Description: Create/list/filter/delete heart rate (bpm), temperature (C) and blood pressure (systolic+diastolic mmHg) with frontend and backend validation limits documented as technical constraints. Owner-only access. REQ-LOG-01. RISK-03.
Acceptance Criteria: Out-of-range or wrong-typed input -> 400; cross-patient access denied; delete works for owner only; tests test_health_logs.py pass.

Summary: Build health logs UI with chart
Description: Form with type-aware fields, readable table with IST timestamps, SVG trend chart, delete confirmation modal.
Acceptance Criteria: Chart renders from real records only; empty state shows guidance; validation errors inline.

Summary: Build PM risk workspace with 5x5 heatmap
Description: Risk register table with filters/search, create/edit modal, close/reopen, metrics from DB and 5x5 matrix with accessible list alternative. Scores computed server-side. REQ-RISK-01.
Acceptance Criteria: Score = P x I enforced; out-of-range P/I rejected 400; matrix plots open risks; accessible list alternative present.

Summary: Run verification suite and record evidence
Description: Run pytest suite (auth, RBAC, booking, conflicts, health logs, risks, persistence, reminders) on isolated file DBs; save log to docs/evidence; record real results in verification table; never record unrun tests. REQ-BOOK-02 etc.
Acceptance Criteria: All tests executed with log saved; verification rows show real run date + evidence path; failures fixed before recording PASS.

column10: Produce SRS, DDS, final report DOCX (exact chapter order with real TOC field), ~10-slide PPTX in VEYORA design language, reflection guide for Krisha, 3-5 minute demo script, and evidence-of-completion placeholders (video link to be added by student after recording).
column11: DOCX opens with heading styles and TOC field; PPTX has ~10 slides; placeholders clearly marked for faculty signature, JIRA screenshots, video link and personal reflection.

Issue Type: import backlog and capture board evidence
Acceptance Criteria: Student action: create JIRA project, import docs/jira-backlog.csv (map fields per docs/jira-setup-guide.md), plan a short sprint, move issues through the workflow, and capture backlog/board/completed screenshots for the report.
column10: Backlog imported; sprint planned; screenshots saved into docs/evidence and inserted under Evidence of Completion; issues carry acceptance criteria.

Description: Student action: record 3-5 minute demo (login -> book -> duplicate conflict -> doctor view -> health log -> linked risk + test evidence) following docs/demo-script.md and upload to LinkedIn/social media; paste link under Evidence of Completion.
Acceptance Criteria: Video recorded and uploaded by Krisha; link added to final report; nothing published without her authorization.
